metric: qualifying documented data-center pipeline site records (proposed, permitted or under construction; confirmed or reported confidence)
peer_method: 40 counties nearest in standardized log population and log population density; data-center counts are not used to choose peers
limitations: Counts are documented site records in one dataset snapshot, not verified counts of buildings or all real projects.
A zero means no qualifying record was found in this snapshot, not that no development is proposed.
Compute Atlas coverage is incomplete and uneven; better-documented places may show more records.
Records with only approximate coordinates are assigned by their source county name, never by the map point.
Peer comparisons are descriptive. They do not show causes, impacts, or statistical significance.
